full_judgment:
5. The trial Court dismissed the suit on the findings that the suit is not bad for defect of party, that the suit as framed is maintainable and not barred by waiver and estoppel, that the plaintiff filed no paper to prove his case of settlement of the land in suit to Bipin Chandra, that plaintiff's case of taking settlement of the land in suit by Bipin Chandra is not correct and that the land in suit was not settled to Bipin Chandra by the landlords, that Bipin Chandra in collusion with survey officials illegally got RS record prepared in his name that in Miscellaneous Case No. 50 of 1978-79 filed by the defendant No. 2 land of plot Nos. 259 and 34 were held to be land used by the Hindu community as Swashan and the said fact was not challenged by Bipin Chandra or by the plaintiff that as Bipin Chandra had no right. title and interest in the land in suit the RS record prepared in his name was not correct, that from plaintiff's side no independent witness was examined to prove the case of settlement said to have been taken by Bipin Chandra, that PW 2 admitted that part of the land in suit is Swashan, that there is no mention which part of the land of respective plots in the land in suit is possessed by the plaintiff, that by the kabala dated February 27, 1970 plaintiff has not acquired any right, title and interest in the land in suit, that the mutation having not been made in the name of the plaintiff upon compliance of the provision of section 117(3) of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950, as such, the same was liable to be cancelled, that the plaintiff is not in exclusive possession of the land in suit, that land in suit being Eidgah, Swashan and Debesthan, etc, the plaintiff did not acquire any title from Bipin Chandra who is said to have taken settlement from the ex-landlords and that settlement to Bipin Chandra by ex-landlords was not proved, that defendants proved by the evidence of DWs 3 and 4 that the land in suit is Eidgah, Swashan and Debesthan, etc., that in view of the evidence and the other materials on record the order dated June 30, 1983 passed in Miscellaneous Case No. 37 of 1981-82 is not illegal.
